shortDescription: Modifies query rules for fast routing policies using the proxysql admin interface

options.name: comment
options.description: Free form text field, usable for a descriptive comment of the query rule.

options.name: config_file
options.description: Specify a config file from which I(login_user) and I(login_password) are to be read.

options.name: database
options.description: Filtering criteria matching database, a query will match only if the connection uses database as its default database.

options.name: destination_hostgroup
options.description: Route matched queries to this hostgroup. This happens unless there is a started transaction and the logged in user has I(transaction_persistent) set to C(True) (refer to M(community.proxysql.proxysql_pgsql_users)).

options.name: flagIN
options.description: Evaluated in the same way as I(flagIN) is in B(pgsql_query_rules) and correlates to the I(flagOUT/apply) specified in the B(pgsql_query_rules) table. (see M(community.proxysql.proxysql_pgsql_query_rules)).

options.name: force_delete
options.description: By default, we avoid deleting more than one query rule in a single batch; however, if you need this behaviour and you are not concerned about the query rules deleted, you can set I(force_delete) to C(True).

options.name: load_to_runtime
options.description: Dynamically load config to runtime memory.

options.name: login_host
options.description: The host used to connect to ProxySQL admin interface.

options.name: login_password
options.description: The password used to authenticate to ProxySQL admin interface.

options.name: login_port
options.description: The port used to connect to ProxySQL admin interface.

options.name: login_unix_socket
options.description: The socket used to connect to ProxySQL admin interface.

options.name: login_user
options.description: The username used to authenticate to ProxySQL admin interface.

options.name: save_to_disk
options.description: Save config to sqlite db on disk to persist the configuration.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), adds the rule. When C(absent), removes the rule.

options.name: username
options.description: Filtering criteria matching username, a query will match only if the connection is made with the correct username.
